newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable, SIR3L down.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable, SIR3L down.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday as SIR3L fell on weak demand, dealers said.
"Shoe-grade SIR3L offer prices for October deliveries edged down to 132 cents/kg from the previous 133 cents/kg due to continued weak demand," one Jakarta-based dealer said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November were at 56.00-56.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.75-56.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 55.25-55.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said there were no significant SIR20 deals heard despite some fresh enquiries from Singapore and Europe.
One Medan-based dealer said he had just signed a deal to ship between October and November around 4,000 tonnes of wet latex to Germany at 93 U.S. cents/kg following a previous deal at 91.00 cents.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
